spec.description: Finished spans per second for chat-ui. The names are the spans this process emits. A gap means no traffic, or Tempo has not remote-written yet.
spec.title: Span rate

spec.description: JSON lines from chat-ui. trace_id and span_id are on the line. The line has no question and no token. The trace_id field opens the Tempo trace.
spec.title: Chat logs

spec.description: Traces whose root is chat.turn. The trace id cell opens the trace. A missing row means the page has not asked, or the exporter is unset.
spec.title: Recent chat traces

spec.description: Spans per second that finished in error for chat-ui. A gap means no errors. Compare it with the logs row.
spec.title: Span errors

spec.description: 95th percentile span duration for chat-ui, in seconds. This is the span, not the HTTP histogram.
spec.title: Span duration p95

spec.description: RED rate. Finished chat turns per second, split by route class. A gap means nobody asked, or Alloy cannot scrape chat-ui:9105.
spec.title: Rate

spec.description: RED duration. 50th and 95th percentile of a whole turn, including the gateway and the model. A turn above a second is usually the model. No samples means nobody asked.
spec.title: Duration

spec.description: USE saturation. 95th percentile of the model call, and of the gateway call in front of it. The model series is absent when no key is set, because the page then prints the snippets.
spec.title: Saturation

spec.description: USE utilization. Tokens per second the model reported, split into prompt and completion. Empty when the page did not call a model. The question is not a label.
spec.title: Utilization

spec.description: RED errors. Turns per second that failed before an answer. A gateway HTTP error counts. A model failure that falls back to the snippets does not. That turn is on the USE errors panel.
spec.title: Errors

spec.description: 95th percentile of edges drawn for a graph or hybrid turn. Zero means that route returned no path the caller could see. A semantic question is not in this series.
spec.title: Graph hops

spec.description: USE errors. Turns per second the model did not write the answer. That is a failed model call that fell back to the snippets, or no key. A gateway failure stays on the RED errors panel.
spec.title: Errors
